business_model.claim: Etsy runs a two-sided online marketplace that connects creative entrepreneurs (sellers) with buyers around the world.
quotes: Etsy operates a two-sided online marketplace that connects millions of creative entrepreneurs with buyers around the world.

business_model.claim: The product offering is unique, creative goods from independent sellers, aimed at consumers looking for items that reflect their tastes and values.
quotes: The Etsy marketplace is the global destination for unique, creative goods from independent sellers, connecting artisans with thoughtful consumers seeking items that reflect their tastes and values.

business_model.claim: Sellers are the main fee payers. Revenue comes mainly from marketplace activities (transaction fees including offsite advertising, payments processing fees, listing fees) and from optional seller services such as on-site advertising and shipping labels.
quotes: We generate revenue primarily from marketplace activities, including transaction fees (inclusive of offsite advertising), payments processing fees, and listing fees, as well as from optional seller services, which include on-site advertising and shipping labels.

Marketplace revenue is primarily comprised of the fees a seller pays for marketplace activities, including transaction fees (inclusive of offsite advertising), payments processing fees, and listing fees.

business_model.claim: In Q3 2026, marketplace revenue was $468,143 (table in thousands), or 67.6% of total revenue. Services revenue was $224,326 (table in thousands), or 32.4%.
The model is asset-light because Etsy holds no physical inventory.
quotes: Because we do not hold physical inventory, we have the ability to lean into our flexible, asset-light operating model and adjust our investments in response to evolving consumer interests and market dynamics.

business_model.claim: After the Depop sale closed on July 30, 2026, continuing operations consist of the Etsy marketplace only. Depop is reported as discontinued operations.
quotes: On July 30, 2026 we completed the sale of Depop.
Continuing operations for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 represent the Etsy marketplace only.

business_model.basis: stated in P4 and the F2 line description
business_model.claim: The Depop sale brought cash consideration of $1.4 billion and a gain of $839.7 million, both recorded in discontinued operations.

quotes: Revenue take rate is revenue divided by GMS.

business_model.claim: The rise in marketplace revenue tracks GMS. Q3 2026 transaction fee revenue rose by $19.6 million and payments revenue by $17.3 million, both because GMS increased.
quotes: Marketplace revenue increased primarily due to a $19.6 million increase in Etsy transaction fee revenue and a $17.3 million increase in Etsy payments revenue, both driven by an increase in GMS.

business_model.claim: Services revenue depends mainly on seller advertising. In Q3 2026, advertising revenue rose by $30.9 million because of higher click volume on Etsy Ads.
quotes: Services revenue increased primarily due to a $30.9 million increase in advertising revenue, primarily driven by higher click volume on Etsy Ads.

business_model.claim: GMS depends on the number of active buyers and on GMS per active buyer. On a trailing twelve-month basis, GMS per active buyer rose 3.9% to $126, and active buyers rose 1.0% to 87.5 million.

business_model.claim: GMS is concentrated among the most active buyers: habitual buyers were about 7% of active buyers but generated about 40% of 2025 GMS.
quotes: Habitual buyers comprised approximately 7% of active buyers and represented about 40% of our 2025 GMS.

business_model.claim: Cost of revenue consists mainly of payments-processing interchange fees and cloud hosting and bandwidth costs. In Q3 2026 it was $189,324 (table in thousands), or 27.3% of revenue, compared with 26.6% a year earlier.

material_events.claim: The Audit Committee approved an operational restructuring plan that cut approximately 12% of the Etsy marketplace workforce, or approximately 220 employees, and led to $33.9 million of restructuring and exit charges in the third quarter.

material_events.claim: Etsy announced that CFO Charles (Lanny) Baker will depart. He is expected to stay in the role for a transition period and then serve as an advisor, and a successor search is under way.
